Dear Claims Team,

I am writing to report a motor vehicle accident that occurred on 15th April 2025. My name is John Smith and I hold policy number AB-12345678.

On the morning of 15 April 2025 at approximately 08:30, I was involved in a collision at the junction of High Street and Park Road, London. A vehicle travelling in the opposite direction crossed into my lane and struck my car on the driver's side. The damage to my vehicle is significant - the door panel, front quarter panel and airbags have deployed. I estimate the repair cost to be around £8,500 based on a preliminary assessment I received from a local garage.

Thankfully there were no fatalities, but I have sustained a whiplash injury and have been advised by my GP to rest for two weeks. The other driver admitted fault at the scene and their details are: Name: David Brown, Reg: LK21 XYZ, Insurer: SafeDrive Insurance.

I have photographs of the damage and a copy of the police report reference P/2025/0412. I would be grateful if you could arrange for an adjuster to contact me at john.smith@email.com or 07700 900123.

Thank you,
John Smith
